description: Human GLP-1R from 6X18 chain R, ECD lid removed, TM bundle cut at -22 A on the pore axis (pocket floor intact: 0 A2 spurious pore exposure vs the uncut bundle); 186 residues in five segments. 39 outward-facing hydrophobics charge-swapped to alternating Glu/Lys. Hotspots Arg190 and Gln234 only; 59 coldspots.
